cardEditor.title: Card Editor
cardEditor.selection.sessionStarted: Bulk session started for {{count}} characters. Follow its progress in Agents → Card Editor.
cardEditor.dialog.title: Bulk Card Editor
cardEditor.dialog.targets.title: Targets · {{count}} characters
cardEditor.dialog.targets.empty: No targets left — close and select at least one character.
cardEditor.dialog.model.title: Model
cardEditor.dialog.model.customTemplateHi: The full prompt template sent for every card. Choosing Custom prefills this field with the current preset's body.
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.title: Instructions & references
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.globalPla: Applies to every card — e.g. tighten prose, remove meta commentary…
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.behaviorH: One card whose behavior, judgment, and writing style guide how edits are written. The directive and notes still decide what changes.
cardEditor.dialog.instructions.lorebooks: Reference context applied to every card.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.title: Processing
cardEditor.dialog.processing.modeBatched: Batched — XML, N cards per call
cardEditor.dialog.processing.rebalanceHi: Splits content into Description / Personality / Backstory / Appearance / Scenario.
cardEditor.dialog.processing.overflowCap: On context overflow the failed batch is split and re-dispatched automatically until single-card calls remain.
cardEditor.dialog.saving.title: Saving
cardEditor.dialog.saving.caption: In-place always writes a new revision. Auto-approve holds back cards that genuinely changed mid-run for review. Duplicates get the suffix " (Edited)".
